description: This Java class 'FileSystemContentPathSanitizer' is responsible for sanitizing content file paths within a content repository system. It performs path normalization, whitelist validation, MIME type verification using Apache Tika, and safeguards against directory traversal attacks. It is annotated as a Spring Component and uses Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: FileSystemContentPathSanitizer
classes.description: A class that sanitizes file system content paths to prevent path traversal, enforce whitelist rules, and validate MIME types.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the regex whitelist patterns after construction, compiling them from configuration.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Overloaded method to sanitize a provided path, with optional input stream for MIME type validation.

methods.name: detectContentMimeType
methods.description: Uses Apache Tika to detect the MIME type of the content read from a BufferedInputStream.
